name: porchfest-board-dashboard
description: Board-facing PorchFest dashboard. A self-contained Observable Framework static site (its own build, its own deps) bridged into the Next app at /porchfest/dashboard, exactly the way the BlockSuite workspace bundle is bridged in rather than imported. Data loaders run at build time; the browser only ever sees precomputed snapshots, so no database or service credential is shipped.
